headline: AI Engineer Salary in the UK 2026: Complete Pay Guide
metaDescription: AI engineer salary UK 2026: national range GBP 50k-90k, London midpoint GBP 89.5k, senior 100k-140k. Compare ML engineer pay, top employers and hiring tips.

sections.content:
AI engineering is one of the best-paid software disciplines in Britain in 2026, with a 15 to 25 percent premium over general software engineers. Robert Half's 2026 salary guide places the national range at GBP 50,000 to 90,000, with the 50th percentile at GBP 65,750 — figures that reflect base salary before bonuses.

London-focused data runs hotter: ITJobsWatch reported a City of London median AI engineer salary of GBP 88,750 in October 2026, up 7.6 percent year on year, and Indeed lists a London AI and machine learning engineer average of GBP 83,501. The spread between national and London figures shows how geography dominates UK tech pay.
sections.title: Average AI Engineer Salary in the UK for 2026

sections.content:
Entry and junior AI engineers earn GBP 50,000 to 75,000 in base salary, with total compensation of GBP 55,000 to 90,000 once bonuses land. Graduate AI roles start lower, at roughly GBP 35,700 to 39,500, typically at larger employers with structured schemes.

Mid-level engineers with three to five years earn GBP 75,000 to 100,000 in base salary. Senior engineers earn GBP 100,000 to 140,000 base, with total compensation reaching GBP 180,000 or more when bonuses and equity are included — well above most other software specialisms.
sections.title: Salary by Seniority

sections.content:
London sets the ceiling: Robert Half puts the capital's AI engineer midpoint at GBP 89,500. Regional hubs such as Manchester, Edinburgh and Bristol pay less in absolute terms but can win on a cost-of-living-adjusted basis, and remote roles at national firms increasingly match London bands for experienced hires.

Machine learning engineers track closely: the national ML engineer range is GBP 60,000 to 95,000 with a GBP 75,000 midpoint, rising to a GBP 102,000 midpoint in London. Either title pays the AI premium; employers care more about what you ship than which label is on the posting.
sections.title: London vs Regional Cities and ML Engineer Pay

sections.content:
The highest packages sit at frontier AI labs and elite finance. Google DeepMind is the reference employer for research-grade roles; Big Tech including Google, Meta and Amazon pay strongly with large equity components. In finance, firms like Citadel and Two Sigma pay senior AI engineers GBP 120,000 to 265,000 or more.

AI startups often trade lower base salaries for meaningful equity upside, which can outperform in a successful exit but offers no guarantee. The fastest way to raise pay is specialization in scarce areas such as LLM fine-tuning, agentic systems or MLOps, backed by a portfolio of shipped AI work with measured impact — demonstrated output beats certificates when negotiating between competing offers.
